construction_review: The inverse of the actual f.residueFieldMap at t is followed by the equality transport from f(t) to the image of p and the actual residue embedding of p. Applying Spec contravariantly and the canonical residue point of T gives the required actual map. Naturality, inverse cancellation and the actual residue factorization prove q≫f=p; fromSpecResidueField_apply proves its exact centre. The structural equation follows by associativity.
